name: Curtin Peter Bradford Scholarship
summary: One-off $2,500 for WA-based Curtin bachelor students from a low socioeconomic background in financial hardship.
who: Australian citizen or permanent resident, based in Western Australia
Enrolled in an undergraduate bachelor degree with at least 50 credits
From a low socioeconomic background and experiencing financial hardship
Current students need a course weighted average of at least 60; commencing students an ATAR of 75
how: Apply through the Equity Scholarship Program form in OASIS (My Studies tab)
catches: The 2026 Semester 1 round opened 21/01/2026 and closed 25/02/2026; check for the next round
Preference for students who moved from remote or regional areas
